payout_quote: Enjoy up to a $300 Bonus. Open your checking account: Apply online or visit your local M&T Bank to open an eligible account by October 8, 2026 using the promo code found on the application page. Set up Direct Deposits: Set up and receive qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $500 within 90 days of account opening. Earn up to a $300 cash bonus: Your cash bonus will be awarded within 90 days after completing the qualifying direct deposits. Eligible: EZChoice Checking, MyChoice Plus Checking, MyChoice Plus Checking with Interest, or MyChoice Premium Checking. Tiers: MYCHOICE PREMIUM $300 cash bonus | MYCHOICE PLUS $250 cash bonus | EZCHOICE $200 cash bonus. Monthly maintenance: MyChoice Premium $24.95/month (waived with $7,500+ avg daily balance or $25,000+ combined balances); MyChoice Plus $14.95/month (waived with $2,500+ avg daily balance or $1,500+ direct deposits per cycle); EZChoice: no monthly maintenance charge, no minimum balance requirement. (Official M&T Bank campaigns pages, crawled 2026-09-23)
